alerts.title: Expiry alerts
alerts.description: Choose how you want to be notified when a contract is about to expire.

inapp_only.label: In-app only
inapp_only.description: You only receive notifications within the application, no emails.

email.label: Email only
email.description: You only receive an email for critical contract warnings, no in-app notification.

all.label: In-app and email (default)
all.description: You receive both an in-app notification and an email for critical contract warnings.

toast.savedDescription: Your notification settings have been updated.
toast.errorDescription: Could not save preferences. Please try again.
